worldcover.reference: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 (10 m), independent of GeoSense
worldcover.caveat: WorldCover has its own errors (about 77% overall accuracy globally) and is from 2021; agreement is evidence of consistency, not proof.

aqi_idw_loso.method: leave-one-station-out, same IDW settings (k, power, max distance)

caveats: Signals are statistical associations within one snapshot, not causal proof.
LST cells with <30% cloud-free Landsat pixels are excluded rather than filled.
Water Health is a satellite spectral proxy, not laboratory water quality.
AQI enters the models only when a real OpenAQ CPCB-network station surface exists.
